REMOVAL SERVICE POINT
<<A>> A/C PIPE REMOVAL
CAUTION
Seal the pipes completely, otherwise the compressor oil 
and receiver will absorb water vapor easily, possibly 
damaging the compressor and deteriorating performance.
Plug the disconnected pipe and the evaporator nipple to 
prevent foreign material from getting into them.
INSTALLATION SERVICE POINT
>>A<< EVAPORATOR INSTALLATION
When replacing the evaporator, refill with a specified amount of 
compressor oil and install it.
Compressor oil: SUN PAG 56
Quantity: 60 cm3 (2.0 floz)
